issue.title: Including memmapped_file_system for Windows in the BUILD file

repository.name: tensorflow
repository.description: Computation using data flow graphs for scalable machine learning

issue.body: This avoids the error related to "memmapped" undeclared on Windows.

body: This would be useful for the DeepSpeech project progress, so any chance you could take a quick look at this @mrry or point us in the direction of the right person to talk to? Thanks!
Hello, @mrry can we get some feedback on this patch ? Should this be upstreamed ? Thanks !
Hello, can we get some update here ? @mrry @petewarden

As far as I can tell, it should be fine to build that code on Windows. The version history is fuzzy, but I think @meteorcloudy added the exception originally [in October 2016](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/commit/c5ab3dd177dc16bb211821e38219f350a613b5e8) when it didn't work on Windows, but support for `WinReadOnlyMemoryRegion` was contributed [shortly afterwards](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/commit/e2d51a87f0727f8537b46048d8241aeebb6e48d6).
